FIELDS.NAME: The Cutting Edge Barbershop
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At The Cutting Edge Barbershop, we provide a variety of grooming services designed to meet the needs of our diverse clientele. Our offerings include hair cutting, styling, dyeing, shaving, conditioning, and shampooing. We operate within a dedicated commercial space, ensuring compliance with all local and state regulations. Our team consists of licensed and certified professionals, each adeptly trained in industry best practices to guarantee exceptional service and customer satisfaction. We utilize only professional-grade products and equipment, minimizing any potential liabilities associated with substandard materials. Health and safety are paramount in our operations, and we maintain rigorous sanitation protocols to protect both our clients and staff. With a focused approach to customer service, we promote an inviting and accessible environment for walk-in and appointment-based clients alike. Our commitment to quality and compliance emphasizes our dedication to providing superior services while effectively managing risks within our operations.
